papers.title: SuperMimic: Scaling Humanoid Whole-Body Control with One Differentiable World Model
papers.abstract: Tracking large human-motion datasets has become the dominant route to general, expressive humanoid whole-body control, but scaling across many motions is expensive. Current pipelines use model-free reinforcement learning, either merging per-motion specialists through lossy distillation, or brute-forcing a single policy with cluster-scale compute. SuperMimic amortizes learning across all motions with one differentiable world model of their shared dynamics, fit from logged transitions of a standard rigid-body simulator. The world model and the tracking policy train together in one loop, and backpropagation-through-time over short imagined rollouts gives the policy analytic gradients. Fast imagined rollouts and analytic gradients make policy learning efficient. In 3 hours on a single GPU, SuperMimic surpasses the return of a state-of-the-art motion tracker baseline trained for 7 days on 128 GPUs. It reduces GPU-hours by more than $1000\times$ and fails on only 25 of 129,514 benchmark motions, versus 179 failures for the baseline. After 9.8 hours on two GPUs, SuperMimic achieves zero failures. From 1 to 264 hours of motion, the world model's prediction error stays stable, and GPU-hours to a target return grow slowly. Our policy transfers to a physical Unitree G1 across diverse and acrobatic motions. SuperMimic removes compute as the bottleneck to scaling humanoid whole-body control, making it practical to measure motion-tracking scaling laws.

ai_summary.problem: 这篇论文要解决人形机器人全身控制中，大规模动作跟踪训练成本极高的问题：现有无模型强化学习依赖逐动作专家蒸馏或大规模算力暴力训练，难以扩展到海量动作数据。
ai_summary.method: 核心方法是学习一个可微的世界模型来建模所有动作共享的动力学，并用标准刚体仿真器的日志转移训练；世界模型与跟踪策略在同一循环中联合训练，通过短时想象 rollout 的反向传播为策略提供解析梯度，从而高效学习。
ai_summary.result: 在单 GPU 3 小时内，SuperMimic 超过在 128 GPU 上训练 7 天的 SOTA 动作跟踪基线，GPU 小时数降低超过 1000 倍；129,514 个基准动作仅失败 25 个（基线失败 179 个），两 GPU 9.8 小时后实现零失败，并可迁移到真实 Unitree G1。
ai_summary.novelty: 创新点在于用一个可微世界模型摊销所有动作的学习，并通过短时想象 rollout 的解析梯度高效训练全身跟踪策略，从而把算力从扩展人形全身控制的瓶颈中移除。
ai_summary.relevance: 这项工作使大规模人形全身控制训练变得可行，并让测量动作跟踪的缩放定律成为可能，对具身智能和机器人基础策略学习具有重要意义。

papers.title: AEON: Unifying Video and 3D World Models
papers.abstract: Current world models for explicit world simulation typically follow two distinct pathways: (1) video generative models (e.g., Sora), which simulate realistic appearances but fail to preserve 3D consistency; and (2) 3D generative models (e.g., Marble), which generate geometrically consistent scenes but often yield static, less realistic observations. We present AEON, a unified framework that bridges video-based and 3D-based world models and combines the benefits of both. The key insight of AEON lies in a generative model that operates within the text- or image-conditioned video latent space while producing renderable 4D graphics primitives---specifically, 4D Gaussian Splatting (4DGS)---as the explicit world representation. We train a 4D reconstruction model to predict both 4DGS and camera poses from monocular videos, serving as our initialized 4D decoder. Furthermore, we design a domain adapter that translates generative video latents into reconstructive 4D latents through a distillation process on the video VAE. AEON naturally supports video-based world modeling by rendering 4DGS at predicted camera trajectories, and constructs a persistent 4D environment with scene dynamics for realistic world simulation. Consequently, AEON empowers a diverse range of world modeling applications and achieves state-of-the-art performance on standard benchmarks. Project Page: https://weiqi-zhang.github.io/AEON

ai_summary.problem: 现有世界模型分为视频生成模型（外观真实但缺乏3D一致性）和3D生成模型（几何一致但静态、真实感不足）两条路线，论文旨在统一二者，同时获得真实感与3D/4D一致性。
ai_summary.method: AEON 在文本或图像条件化的视频潜空间中生成可渲染的4D Gaussian Splatting（4DGS）作为显式世界表示；先用单目视频训练4D重建模型预测4DGS与相机位姿作为初始化的4D解码器，再通过视频VAE上的蒸馏设计域适配器，将生成式视频潜变量转换为重建式4D潜变量。推理时在预测相机轨迹上渲染4DGS即可实现视频式世界建模，并构建含场景动态的持久4D环境。
ai_summary.result: AEON 同时支持视频式世界建模与持久4D环境构建，可覆盖多样化的世界模拟应用，并在标准基准上取得SOTA性能。
ai_summary.novelty: 首次将视频生成潜空间与可渲染的4DGS显式表示通过蒸馏式域适配器统一起来，实现兼具真实感与4D一致性的世界模型。
ai_summary.relevance: 为世界模型提供了一条融合视频生成与3D/4D几何表示的可行范式，对具身智能、可交互仿真与多模态生成研究具有推动作用。

papers.title: UniWALM: Unified World Action Language Model for Embodied Robot Control
papers.abstract: Motivated by the human ability to integrate experience across language, perception, and action, we introduce UniWALM, a unified world-action-language model that learns video, action, and language in a single shared representation, where each modality is both a conditioning signal and a supervision target. We ask: can jointly generating language enrich this shared representation, improving manipulation and supporting memory-dependent behavior? Unlike prior approaches that attach a reasoning or vision-language model to a video-action backbone and run them as distinct stages, UniWALM unifies all three modalities inside a single mixture-of-transformers backbone whose per-modality diffusion heads co-denoise synchronously, decoding subtask and textual memory in the same pass as action with no separate planning stage; the generated language is re-consumed on the next step, closing a language-as-memory loop without an external planner or memory bank. To keep the action stream reliable under this richer objective, we further introduce Flow Matching with Correction (FMC), a training objective that teaches recovery from perturbed action trajectories at no inference-time cost. UniWALM consistently improves over same-backbone baselines (e.g., FastWAM) on compositional pick-and-place (MolmoSpaces) and across the memory-dependent subset of RMBench, where it reaches 34.5% without any pretrained language or reasoning model and exceeds Mem-0's keyframe-equipped setup (28.5%) using only a single anchor frame. On a real-world Find-the-Item task, generating textual memory lifts success from 11.1% to 61.1%, while state-of-the-art VLAs stay at or below chance (<=33.3%).

ai_summary.problem: 现有具身控制方法通常把推理/视觉语言模型与视频-动作主干分成两个独立阶段运行，缺少统一表示，导致依赖记忆的长程任务（如按指令找物品）表现不佳。论文探究在同一共享表示中联合生成语言能否增强操作能力并支撑记忆依赖行为。
ai_summary.method: 提出 UniWALM，在单个 Mixture-of-Transformers 主干内统一视频、动作与语言，每种模态既是条件信号也是监督目标，各模态的扩散头同步去噪，一次前向即可同时解码子任务文本、文本记忆与动作，无需独立规划阶段。生成的语言在下一步被重新消费，形成“语言即记忆”闭环；并引入 Flow Matching with Correction (FMC) 训练目标，使动作流能从扰动轨迹中恢复且不增加推理开销。
ai_summary.result: 在 MolmoSpaces 组合式拾放任务和 RMBench 记忆依赖子集上稳定优于同主干基线（如 FastWAM）；RMBench 达 34.5%（无预训练语言/推理模型、仅用单锚帧），超过带关键帧的 Mem-0（28.5%）。真实 Find-the-Item 任务中生成文本记忆将成功率从 11.1% 提升到 61.1%，而 SOTA VLA 仅接近随机（≤33.3%）。
ai_summary.novelty: 用单一 MoT 主干让语言、视频、动作同步联合去噪，并把生成的语言作为下一步记忆闭环复用，首次在无外部规划器/记忆库条件下实现语言增强的具身控制。
ai_summary.relevance: 为世界模型与具身智能提供了“语言即记忆”的统一多模态建模范式，表明联合生成语言可实质提升长程记忆依赖操作，对统一世界-动作-语言模型方向有参考价值。
ai_summary.org: 作者机构信息缺失，未能确定（Diego Romeres 等通常与 MERL 相关）

papers.title: Physical Canvas: A Vision Tactile World Model For Robot Policy Evaluation And Learning
papers.abstract: Evaluating and post-training robot policies through physical interaction is costly and difficult to scale, motivating action-conditioned world models as interactive simulators. However, visually plausible predictions can misrepresent contact dynamics, providing unreliable feedback for policy evaluation and learning. We introduce PhysCanvas, a state-consistent visuo-tactile world model for contact-rich robot manipulation. PhysCanvas unifies multi-view RGB, tactile images, marker displacement, task state, and actions within a unified vision space. All modalities share a video VAE and pretrained generative backbone, allowing optical touch to reuse visual and temporal priors. Motion images derived through forward kinematics and camera projection provide spatially aligned action conditioning, while an initial RGB anchor and updated reference observations guide sequential generation. Our consistency-aware post-training uses the frozen Scene Reward Model, Modality Reward Model, and State Reward Model to supervise scene preservation, visual-tactile compatibility, and agreement with real task outcomes. The resulting world model supports closed-loop policy rollouts for evaluation and provides imagined interactions and rewards for GRPO policy updates. Across four real-world manipulation tasks, when policies are rolled out in the world model, State Reward Model supervision increases the arithmetic mean of task-wise Pearson correlations between world-model and real-world success rates from 0.602 to 0.885. Policy post-training in the reward-guided world model further increases $π_{0.5}$'s mean real-world success rate from a 59.1% SFT baseline to 70.8%. These results demonstrate the value of unified multimodal modeling and consistency-aware post-training for robot policy evaluation and learning. Project page: https://zebinx.github.io/PhysCanvas_HomePage/.

ai_summary.problem: 机器人策略的评估与后训练需要大量昂贵的真实物理交互，难以规模化；而仅依赖视觉的世界模型虽然预测画面逼真，却常常错误刻画接触动力学，导致对策略的反馈不可靠。
ai_summary.method: 提出 PhysCanvas，一个状态一致的多模态视触觉世界模型：把多视角 RGB、触觉图像、marker 位移、任务状态和动作统一到同一个视觉空间，共享视频 VAE 与预训练生成主干，使“光学触觉”复用视觉与时间先验；并用正运动学与相机投影生成空间对齐的运动图作为动作条件。训练后阶段引入冻结的 Scene / Modality / State 三个奖励模型，分别约束场景保持、视触一致性和与真实任务结果的一致性。
ai_summary.result: 在四个真实操作任务上，世界模型闭环 rollout 与真机成功率的任务级 Pearson 相关均值从 0.602 提升到 0.885；在奖励引导的世界模型中做 GRPO 后训练，使 π0.5 的真实平均成功率从 SFT 基线 59.1% 提升到 70.8%。
ai_summary.novelty: 首次将触觉以“视觉化”方式与多视角 RGB、本体状态和动作统一进单一视频生成世界模型，并用多奖励一致性后训练校准接触动力学，使世界模型既能评估策略又能提供想象交互用于策略改进。
ai_summary.relevance: 为机器人世界模型提供了可扩展的策略评估与后训练替代方案，说明多模态统一建模与一致性约束是让生成式模拟器在接触丰富任务中可信的关键。

papers.title: Learning the 4D World through Point Trajectory Forecasting
papers.abstract: Reliable multi-view forecasting requires videos from different cameras to describe the same evolving 3D scene. To this end, we introduce Video-Point Model (VPM), a world model that conditions on multi-view video histories and a language instruction to jointly forecast future videos from arbitrary viewpoints and the 3D trajectories of persistent scene points. We extend a pretrained world model with camera-conditioned multi-view processing that integrates complementary observations across cameras, and add a trajectory head that predicts how physical points move through time. Each trajectory tracks a single point across all views, and supervising these trajectories alongside video generation therefore anchors appearance changes in every camera to a shared description of 3D motion. To support training and evaluation, we build VPM-Data, a simulation corpus pairing synchronized multi-view videos with persistent point trajectories, and VP-WorldBench, a forecasting benchmark spanning simulated and real environments. We further extend VPM to robot control by adding robot actions as a token modality in the generator. Action tokens share the point-supervised backbone and are denoised jointly with future videos, thereby grounding the policy in the same 3D-aware representation. On VP-WorldBench and existing 4D generation benchmarks, point supervision improves both video fidelity and 3D motion accuracy over a video-only counterpart, and in simulated and real-robot experiments, it also raises the manipulation success of the action-enabled model.

ai_summary.problem: 多视角视频预测需要不同相机描述同一 evolving 3D 场景，但现有视频世界模型缺乏显式的共享 3D 运动约束，难以保证跨视角一致性和 3D 运动准确性。
ai_summary.method: 论文提出 Video-Point Model (VPM)，以多视角视频历史和语言指令为条件，联合预测任意视角的未来视频与持续场景点的 3D 轨迹。它扩展预训练世界模型，加入相机条件多视角处理模块和轨迹头，并用跨所有视角的单点轨迹监督将各相机外观变化锚定到共享 3D 运动；进一步将机器人动作作为 token 模态加入生成器，与未来视频联合去噪以支持控制。
ai_summary.result: 在 VP-WorldBench 和现有 4D 生成基准上，点轨迹监督相比仅视频模型提升了视频保真度和 3D 运动精度；在仿真和真实机器人实验中，引入动作的模型也提高了操作成功率。
ai_summary.novelty: 核心创新是联合预测多视角未来视频与持久 3D 点轨迹，用共享点轨迹监督形成 3D 感知表示，并扩展到动作 token 以统一世界建模与机器人策略。
ai_summary.relevance: 该工作推动了 4D 世界模型、多视角视频生成与具身智能的结合，为构建具有 3D 运动一致性和可控制策略的世界模型提供了新路径。

papers.title: GPT-6-Astra Understands Touch and Outperform Vision--Tactile--Language--Action Models
papers.abstract: General-purpose multimodal models have shown promise as direct robot action policies, yet whether they grasp the physics underlying real-world interactions and can apply that understanding to guide action remains underexplored. We investigate this question using contact-rich manipulation as a representative testbed, examining tactile understanding as a concrete instance of this broader capability. Contact-rich manipulation requires interpreting tactile feedback and adjusting actions after obstruction. Existing learned tactile policies acquire these capabilities through specialized pretraining and per-task optimization, with substantial data and training costs. We present GPT-as-Tactile-Policy, which summarizes expert demonstrations into task guidance and tactile references for contact assessment and corrective action. GPT-6-Astra combines this context with multimodal observations and interaction history to generate control commands and adjust actions through contact feedback. Without additional robotics-specific pretraining or per-task policy fine-tuning, our method achieves 93.8\% mean success across five UniVTAC tasks. Overall performance is comparable to state-of-the-art policies, with higher success on selected tasks. On Insert Hole, tactile feedback improves success from 31\% to 99\%. Execution analysis further demonstrates contact-guided probing and correction, supporting manipulation progress through explicit expert experience and online feedback.

ai_summary.problem: 通用多模态模型作为机器人直接动作策略时，是否真正理解真实交互中的接触物理并利用触觉反馈指导动作仍不清楚；富接触操作尤其需要解释触觉并在受阻后纠正动作。
ai_summary.method: 提出 GPT-as-Tactile-Policy：将专家演示总结为任务引导和触觉参考，结合多模态观测与交互历史，由 GPT-6-Astra 生成控制命令，并依据接触反馈调整动作；无需额外的机器人专用预训练或逐任务策略微调。
ai_summary.result: 在五个 UniVTAC 任务上取得 93.8% 平均成功率，与最先进策略相当且在部分任务上更高；在 Insert Hole 任务中，触觉反馈将成功率从 31% 提升到 99%，并展示出接触引导的探测与纠正行为。
ai_summary.novelty: 将通用多模态大模型直接用作触觉策略，通过专家经验摘要和在线触觉反馈实现免机器人预训练、免任务微调的富接触操作。
ai_summary.relevance: 表明通用多模态模型可理解触觉并用于机器人动作决策，为具身智能和世界模型中的多模态物理理解提供了新范式。
ai_summary.org: 中山大学（Sun Yat-sen University）

papers.title: DIVE: Benchmarking Full-Duplex Interaction with Visual Engagement in Continuous Streams
papers.abstract: Recent advances in multimodal large language models (MLLMs) have substantially improved spoken interaction and video understanding. Existing online and streaming benchmarks primarily assess causal multimodal perception through timestamped question answering, whereas real-world interaction requires models to continuously identify task-relevant multimodal cues and decide whether, when, and how to respond. This leaves open how well current models can sustain real-time interaction throughout an evolving multimodal stream. To address this gap, we introduce DIVE, a benchmark for evaluating full-duplex interaction with visual engagement under continuous and realistic multimodal streams. It organizes six tasks into three complementary interaction scenarios. (1) Proactive Intervention evaluates whether models can identify emerging visual or semantic cues and intervene at the appropriate moment. (2) Continuous Engagement evaluates sustained participation through continuous visual tracking and visually grounded query interaction. (3) Interaction Coordination evaluates how models coordinate listening and speaking under overlapping and multi-party interactions. DIVE contains 525 audio/video samples with fine-grained human annotations and precise temporal metadata. Its evaluation protocol separates response quality, participation decisions, and response timing. We evaluate representative real-time models using response quality, window response rates, and reaction latency. Experiments show that leading real-time models achieve sub-second average response latency, yet their average window response rates remain at or below 53.77%. Response quality varies substantially across models and tasks, with adapting ongoing responses to newly arriving information remaining particularly challenging. We hope DIVE facilitates progress toward more natural and capable real-time multimodal interactive systems.

ai_summary.problem: 现有在线/流式多模态基准主要评估带时间戳的问答式因果感知，无法衡量模型在连续音视频流中是否、何时以及如何主动响应并维持实时交互。
ai_summary.method: 提出 DIVE 基准，包含 525 个带细粒度人工标注和精确时间元数据的音视频样本，围绕主动干预、持续参与和交互协调三类场景设计六项任务，并将响应质量、参与决策和响应时机分开评估。
ai_summary.result: 实验显示领先实时模型平均响应延迟可达亚秒级，但平均窗口响应率不超过 53.77%，响应质量随模型和任务差异明显，且根据新到达信息调整进行中的响应仍尤其困难。
ai_summary.novelty: 构建了面向连续真实多模态流的全双工交互与视觉参与基准，并系统评估响应质量、参与决策和响应时机。
ai_summary.relevance: 为实时多模态大模型从被动问答走向自然、持续、全双工交互提供了标准化评测方向。
ai_summary.org: 未明确（作者机构未提供）

papers.title: Industrial ReMEmbR: Scaling Spatiotemporal Memory to Robot Fleets
papers.abstract: Warehouse robot fleets continuously observe operational conditions, but preserving these observations as reusable semantic memory incurs substantial computation, communication, and storage costs. For example, explaining recurring aisle blockages can require reviewing video from multiple robots across several shifts. We present IndustrialRemembr, a shared spatiotemporal memory system that extends NVIDIA ReMEmbR to robot fleets and reduces server-side computation by generating scene descriptions only on demand. On each robot, an NVIDIA Jetson encodes video clips into retrieval embeddings with Cosmos-Embed1, vision tokens with Cosmos3-Edge, and reconstruction latents with the Wan2.2 VAE, without uploading raw camera frames. The encoding models are re-used to detect people in image patches, zeroing them out to support PII abstraction for GDPR-compliant deployments. We split Cosmos3-Edge at its vision-language boundary, placing the vision encoder on the robot and the language decoder on an on-premises server. A Nemotron agent retrieves memories by content, position, and time and queries the decoder using cached vision tokens. This design eliminates caption generation at write time, while cached-token decoding reproduces the unsplit model's output in all 450 tested decodes.

ai_summary.problem: 仓库机器人车队持续产生大量视频观测，但将其保存为可复用的语义记忆会带来高昂的计算、通信和存储开销（例如排查反复出现的通道堵塞需要回看多台机器人、多个班次的视频）。
ai_summary.method: 提出 IndustrialRemembr，将 NVIDIA ReMEmbR 扩展为面向机器人车队的共享时空记忆系统：机器人端用 Jetson 和 Cosmos-Embed1 生成检索嵌入、用 Cosmos3-Edge 生成视觉 token、用 Wan2.2 VAE 生成重建潜变量，且不上传原始画面；并在视觉-语言边界拆分 Cosmos3-Edge，视觉编码器留在机器人端、语言解码器部署在本地服务器，由 Nemotron agent 按内容、位置和时间检索并调用缓存的视觉 token 按需解码生成描述。同时复用编码模型检测并置零图像块中的人物，以实现符合 GDPR 的 PII 抽象。
ai_summary.result: 该系统把描述生成推迟到按需查询阶段，省去了写入时的 caption 生成，显著降低服务器端计算量；在全部 450 次测试解码中，基于缓存 token 的解码结果与未拆分模型输出一致。
ai_summary.novelty: 将 VLM 沿视觉-语言边界拆分部署、以缓存视觉 token 实现按需描述，并把单机器人语义记忆扩展为车队级共享时空记忆与隐私抽象机制。
ai_summary.relevance: 为具身智能与多机器人系统的长期语义记忆提供了可落地的分布式、隐私合规工程范式，展示了边缘-服务器协同推理在机器人车队中的实用路径。
ai_summary.org: NVIDIA

papers.title: Beyond the Sequentiality Bottleneck: A Hybrid Diffusion-Autoregressive Framework for Efficient Multimodal Reasoning
papers.abstract: Autoregressive models (ARMs) face a "Sequentiality Bottleneck" in reasoning, while diffusion language models (DLMs) offer parallelism but lack semantic coherence. To addresses both limitations, we propose Collaborative Reasoning Asymmetric Learning (CoRAL), a hybrid framework via an Asymmetric Planner-Executor (APE) architecture: a DLM Planner generates K diverse reasoning trajectories in parallel, while a large ARM Executor selects the optimal plan and synthesizes the final answer. To train the Planner effectively, we introduce Reward-Guided Denoising for CoT (RDC), which integrates outcome-based rewards into the diffusion process to steer it toward goal-directed reasoning. Experiments on vision-language benchmarks show that CoRAL significantly outperforms prior diffusion-based methods and achieves competitive performance against strong ARMs, achieving both superior efficiency and quality.

ai_summary.problem: 自回归模型在推理中存在“序列性瓶颈”，而扩散语言模型虽可并行生成但缺乏语义连贯性，论文旨在同时解决这两类模型的局限。
ai_summary.method: 提出CoRAL混合框架，采用非对称规划器-执行器架构：扩散语言模型规划器并行生成K条多样化推理轨迹，大型自回归模型执行器选择最优规划并合成最终答案；同时引入RDC（奖励引导的思维链去噪）将结果奖励融入扩散过程以引导目标导向推理。
ai_summary.result: 在视觉-语言基准上显著优于已有扩散类方法，并与强自回归模型性能相当，同时兼顾更高效率与生成质量。
ai_summary.novelty: 核心创新是非对称规划器-执行器混合架构与奖励引导去噪训练机制，将扩散并行性与自回归语义连贯性结合。
ai_summary.relevance: 为多模态推理提供了一条融合扩散并行生成与自回归语义整合的高效新路径。

papers.title: OverSeer: Multi-Agent World Models Beyond What Agents See
papers.abstract: Despite the success of video world models, extending them to multiple agents is difficult because it requires generating several agent-specific video streams that are consistent in time and between agents. To address this gap, we introduce OverSeer, a multi-agent world model that augments egocentric agent views with auxiliary camera views. We suggest that, by fixing the auxiliary views in space, they act as a proxy for a world-centric representation: Unlike the agents' views, which can change entirely due to a simple change in agent position, changes in the auxiliary views directly map to localized changes in the world state. We show that these fixed views substantially help the model to maintain consistency. We also show that, due to their redundant and semi-static nature, the auxiliary views can be efficiently compressed with a delta-VAE that encodes only the changes relative to a static reference image, reducing the number of tokens required to process them. Experiments in Minecraft and Doom demonstrate improved world and agent consistency, with qualitative results on real-world multi-camera captures indicating that the approach is not tied to game engines. Our compression analysis further shows that delta-VAE substantially reduces the computational overhead of auxiliary-view generation. We conclude that these fixed views provide a simple and efficient way to improve multi-agent world models.

ai_summary.problem: 多智能体视频世界模型难以生成多个智能体视角下时间一致且智能体间一致的视频流。
ai_summary.method: 提出 OverSeer，在智能体的第一人称视角之外引入空间固定的辅助相机视角，作为世界中心表征的代理以提升一致性；并用 delta-VAE 仅编码相对静态参考图像的变化，压缩冗余的半静态辅助视角。
ai_summary.result: 在 Minecraft 和 Doom 中提升了世界一致性与智能体一致性，真实多相机数据上的定性结果说明方法不局限于游戏引擎；压缩分析表明 delta-VAE 显著降低辅助视角生成的计算开销。
ai_summary.novelty: 利用空间固定辅助视角作为世界中心代理，并结合 delta-VAE 高效压缩，提升多智能体世界模型的一致性。
ai_summary.relevance: 为多智能体世界模型提供了一种简单高效的一致性增强与视角压缩思路，对视频世界模型和多智能体模拟有参考价值。

papers.title: VLM-Guided Contact Retargeting and Generative Partner Modeling for Humanoid-Human Interaction
papers.abstract: Humanoid-human interaction requires robots to operate under severe partial observability: during close physical contact, the human partner is occluded, truncated, or outside the robot's field of view, causing pose estimation to fail and often necessitating external tracking or privileged human state. At the same time, heavy mutual occlusions introduce errors into the human-human motion-capture data used for learning. We present REACT, a framework for learning deployable humanoid-human interaction policies from human-human demonstrations. REACT treats semantic contact structure as the key supervisory signal connecting demonstration processing, interaction learning, and onboard control. First, a VLM-guided contact modeling and retargeting pipeline identifies semantically meaningful contacts and transfers them onto humanoid-human geometry while preserving interaction structure. Using these annotations, privileged interaction policies learn physically grounded behaviors through interaction-aware contact rewards and are then distilled into deployable egocentric depth policies trained entirely from onboard sensing using photorealistic human depth rendering. To address severe partial observability, we introduce generative partner-state modeling objectives that predict partner motion from occluded egocentric views. We evaluate REACT in simulation and on a real Unitree G1 humanoid across five contact-rich interactions. Semantic contact modeling substantially improves preservation of demonstrated interactions, while generative partner-state modeling improves contact recall on four of five interactions, most under heavy occlusion. On real hardware, REACT performs all five interactions using onboard sensing alone.

ai_summary.problem: 这篇论文要解决人形机器人在人-人交互中因严重部分可观测性导致的人体姿态估计失败问题，例如近距离接触时人类伙伴被遮挡、截断或不在视野内，同时人-人动捕数据也受相互遮挡影响。
ai_summary.method: 提出 REACT 框架，从人-人演示中学习可部署的人形-人交互策略。核心包括：VLM 引导的语义接触建模与重定向，将语义接触结构迁移到人形-人几何上；利用接触奖励学习特权交互策略，并通过逼真人体深度渲染蒸馏为仅依赖机载感知的自我中心深度策略；引入生成式伙伴状态建模，从被遮挡的自我中心视角预测伙伴运动。
ai_summary.result: 在仿真和真实 Unitree G1 人形机器人上评估五种接触丰富交互。语义接触建模显著提升演示交互保留度；生成式伙伴状态建模在五种交互中的四种提升接触召回率，尤其在严重遮挡下效果明显；真实硬件上仅用机载感知完成全部五种交互。
ai_summary.novelty: 将语义接触结构作为连接演示处理、交互学习与机载控制的关键监督信号，并结合 VLM 引导重定向与生成式伙伴状态建模，实现遮挡下可部署的人形-人交互策略。
ai_summary.relevance: 该工作推动人形机器人在真实部分可观测环境中仅依赖机载感知完成复杂人-人物理交互，对具身智能、人形机器人和多模态感知控制具有参考价值。
ai_summary.org: Keio University（庆应义塾大学，依据作者信息推断）

papers.title: DISTRACT: Degradation-Indexed Study of Textual Reference Across Competing Targets
papers.abstract: Vision-language trackers (VLTs) accept descriptions intended to assist tracking, but accepting text does not establish that its content changes tracking decisions, particularly as visual evidence deteriorates. We introduce DISTRACT, a matched-intervention benchmark that holds video, target, and distractor fixed while crossing four text priors with four image degradations along a controlled severity axis. We evaluate five VLTs on four datasets using behavioral contrasts, layerwise representation probes, and activation patching. Molmo2 and JointNLT exhibit directed text use. Some effects contract under degradation, whereas others show no significant endpoint change after multiplicity correction. UVLTrack, MMTrack, and DUTrack respond only weakly to changes in text semantics, with no directed behavioral effect surviving FDR correction in the tested settings. Model-internal analyses reveal that at decision-near states, correct-versus-conflicting text is decodable in Molmo2 and JointNLT but not in the other three systems. In the responsive models, decodability peaks at late states where replacement produces little behavioral change, whereas replacing selected earlier states redirects conflict-associated trajectories toward the target. Because matched-correct donors do not significantly outperform unrelated donors, these interventions identify earlier intervention-sensitive states without establishing target-specific semantic rescue. DISTRACT thus exposes when and where text affects tracking under degraded visual evidence.

ai_summary.problem: 视觉-语言跟踪器虽然接受文本描述，但尚不清楚文本语义是否真正改变跟踪决策，尤其是在视觉证据退化时。
ai_summary.method: 提出 DISTRACT 匹配干预基准，固定视频、目标和干扰物，将四种文本先验与四种图像退化在可控严重度轴上交叉；在四个数据集上评估五个 VLT，并结合行为对比、逐层表征探针和激活修补分析。
ai_summary.result: Molmo2 和 JointNLT 表现出有方向的文本使用，决策附近状态可解码正确/冲突文本，且较早状态对干预敏感；UVLTrack、MMTrack 和 DUTrack 对文本语义变化响应较弱，经 FDR 校正后无显著定向行为效应。干预未证明目标特异性语义救援。
ai_summary.novelty: 通过匹配干预基准与模型内部因果分析，系统揭示视觉退化下文本在何时、何处影响跟踪行为。
ai_summary.relevance: 有助于评估多模态跟踪器的语言忠实性、鲁棒性及文本条件是否真正参与决策。
ai_summary.org: Ben-Gurion University of the Negev

papers.title: A Multi-Agent Framework for Automated Machine Learning with Evidence-based Planning for Medical Image Analysis
papers.abstract: Deep learning has become the default tool for medical image analysis, driven by the open-source movement. However, achieving the best performance on a given task remains difficult, with architecture selection and hyperparameter optimization (HPO) still considered "more of an art than a science". Automated machine learning (AutoML) automates parts of model training, yet helps little in medical imaging: general-purpose approaches lack medical architectures and preprocessing, and medical-focused ones demand engineering expertise and remain confined to narrow tasks such as 3D segmentation. We introduce MedicalMLOmni, a multi-agent AutoML framework that automates model training for diverse single- and multi-modal medical tasks through a natural language interface. Specifically, MedicalMLOmni performs evidence-based planning by retrieving published results to guide model selection and configuration, and employs parallel HPO where multiple agents explore adjustment strategies concurrently. MedicalMLOmni achieves the best score on 19 of 20 benchmarks; PMC-VQA is the exception, where a vision-language model with broader pre-training leads. Backbone-matched controls attribute the gains to the framework, not the backbone. By removing coding requirements, MedicalMLOmni lowers the barrier for domain experts with rich datasets but limited engineering expertise.

ai_summary.problem: 医学图像分析中的模型架构选择和超参数优化仍高度依赖专家经验；现有通用 AutoML 缺乏医学专用架构与预处理，医学专用 AutoML 又要求工程能力且多局限于 3D 分割等狭窄任务。
ai_summary.method: 提出 MedicalMLOmni，一个通过自然语言接口自动完成多种单模态/多模态医学任务模型训练的多智能体 AutoML 框架。它采用基于证据的规划，检索已发表结果来指导模型选择与配置，并使用多个智能体并行探索不同调参策略的并行 HPO。
ai_summary.result: 在 20 个基准中 19 个取得最佳分数，仅 PMC-VQA 例外，由预训练更广的视觉语言模型领先；主干网络匹配的对照实验表明性能提升来自框架而非主干网络，并降低了领域专家的编程门槛。
ai_summary.novelty: 将证据检索驱动的规划与多智能体并行超参数优化结合，构建面向多样化医学图像任务的自然语言 AutoML 框架。
ai_summary.relevance: 展示了多智能体与证据驱动规划在 AutoML 中的潜力，有助于降低医学影像 AI 的使用门槛并推动更广泛的自动化模型开发。
ai_summary.org: Johns Hopkins University（根据作者推断）

papers.title: NarraSpace: Multimodal Scene-Grounded Evidence for Picture-Description Dementia Classification
papers.abstract: Picture-description dementia classification uses a shared visual scene, but a transcript-level prediction alone does not identify the scene evidence underlying its inputs. NarraSpace links words and speech times to named picture elements and retrieves utterances for predefined scene events. Narrative-spatial descriptors summarize coverage and temporal organization. A frozen language model contrasts each event's text under examples from Alzheimer's disease and healthy-control training participants, alongside transcript surprisal and coverage measurements. Retained source records link event scores to their source utterances, speech intervals, and lexical matches. On the official 48-participant test set of the Alzheimer's Dementia Recognition through Spontaneous Speech benchmark, a fixed support vector classifier achieves $80.88\%\pm2.56\%$ mean accuracy over fifty seeds; averaged probabilities yield $81.25\%$ accuracy and $91.32\%$ area under the receiver operating characteristic curve. NarraSpace makes the construction of scene-linked classification inputs explicit and inspectable by connecting event-indexed language-model measurements to their source utterances, speech timing, and extraction records. Such source-linked measurements could support clinician review of picture descriptions by presenting quantitative summaries alongside the original speech evidence.

ai_summary.problem: 图片描述式痴呆分类通常只依赖转写文本做预测，无法明确指出判断所依据的共享视觉场景证据，因而难以审查。NarraSpace 旨在建立场景关联且可追溯的分类证据。
ai_summary.method: 该方法将词语和语音时间对齐到命名图像元素，检索预定义场景事件对应的话语，并构造叙事-空间描述符；用冻结语言模型对每个事件文本与阿尔茨海默病/健康对照示例进行对比，同时结合转写 surprisal 和覆盖率；保留事件分数到源话语、语音区间和词汇匹配的链接，并用固定 SVM 分类。
ai_summary.result: 在 ADReSS 官方 48 人测试集上，固定 SVM 五十个随机种子的平均准确率为 80.88%±2.56%，概率平均后准确率 81.25%，AUC 为 91.32%。方法使场景关联的分类输入显式且可检查。
ai_summary.novelty: 创新在于把场景事件级的语言模型测量与源话语、语音时序和词汇匹配记录显式链接，使图片描述痴呆分类证据可追溯、可审查。
ai_summary.relevance: 对多模态临床语音分析、可解释 AI 和面向临床审查的模型证据展示有参考价值，但应用范围目前主要集中在痴呆筛查任务。
ai_summary.org: 提供信息中未明确作者机构；Satoshi Nakamura 常与日本 NAIST 相关，但需核实

papers.title: Agentic Ensemble with Vision-Language Models for Visual Anomaly Detection
papers.abstract: Visual anomaly detection aims to detect abnormal objects, while anomaly samples are often scarce during model training. Assembling multiple pretrained detectors can help by leveraging their transferable image scores and anomaly maps. However, most existing ensemble methods apply fixed fusion rules over saved predictions which struggle when pretrained detectors clearly disagree due to different training objectives, priors, and visual representations. To this end, we design AnomalyAgent, a post-training fusion framework for accurate visual anomaly detection. AnomalyAgent aligns heterogeneous scores and maps, summarizes score- and region-level disagreement, and treats fusion as a finite action-selection problem. It implements two types of actions: 1) score actions that determine how to fuse image-level detector confidence via consensus, robust aggregation, detector weighting, or score-map consistency; 2) map actions that fuse dense anomaly responses via consensus, detector weighting, geometric aggregation, or disagreement correction. A constrained vision-language model (VLM) is introduced to inspect high-conflict samples and select valid score action and map action to produce the final prediction. We evaluate AnomalyAgent on MVTec AD and VisA as primary benchmarks, together with seven additional public anomaly benchmarks and Real-IAD for large-scale score-level evaluation. Across these benchmarks, AnomalyAgent consistently improves over equal-weight fusion and achieves the best mean image AUROC and pixel AP among the compared fusion methods on MVTec AD and VisA, while demonstrating robust transfer across additional anomaly domains.

ai_summary.problem: 视觉异常检测中异常样本稀缺，现有基于多个预训练检测器的集成方法多采用固定融合规则，当检测器因训练目标、先验和表示不同而明显分歧时融合效果受限。
ai_summary.method: 提出 AnomalyAgent，一个训练后融合框架：先对齐异构的分数和异常图，并总结分数级与区域级分歧，再将融合建模为有限动作选择问题。引入受约束的视觉语言模型检查高冲突样本，选择有效的分数动作和异常图动作来生成最终预测。
ai_summary.result: 在 MVTec AD 和 VisA 上，AnomalyAgent 相比等权融合稳定提升，并在对比的融合方法中取得最佳平均图像 AUROC 和像素 AP；在七个额外异常基准及 Real-IAD 上表现出较好的跨域迁移和可扩展性。
ai_summary.novelty: 将多检测器异常检测融合转化为由受约束 VLM 进行动作选择的 Agentic 后处理框架，而非固定规则融合。
ai_summary.relevance: 为多模型集成与视觉语言模型在异常检测中的后训练协同提供了新思路，对工业视觉和多模态 Agent 应用有参考价值。
ai_summary.org: 作者机构未在提供信息中明确；Shijian Lu 常见隶属新加坡南洋理工大学

papers.title: Exploring Temporal Context-Aware Physical Grounding in Latent World Models
papers.abstract: Learning latent dynamics is fundamental to building action-conditioned world models for planning. Among existing families, Joint Embedding Predictive Architectures (JEPAs) offer a natural framework by modeling transitions directly in latent space rather than at the pixel level. However, two issues remain in JEPA-based world models: (i) physical grounding lacks explicit aggregation of temporal context and (ii) action planning always overly relies on generic sampling distributions. To this end, we propose $\mathcal{G}$-JEPA, which incorporates temporal context into physical grounding for latent world models and couples the learned models with prior-guided action planning. Specifically, during learning, we incorporate a shared causal temporal module that aggregates temporal context within observation and prediction sequences under physical state supervision, grounding both in task-relevant physical states. When planning, we further introduce action inference through stepwise conditioning of a generative action distribution on the current and goal latent representations together with their evolving discrepancy, yielding anchored proposals that guide model-based online refinement. Together, physical state supervision guides temporal representation learning, while the action prior guides search through the learned world model. Experiments demonstrate improved planning performance on manipulation tasks, including tasks with increasing temporal separation between initial and goal observations. Code is publicly available at https://github.com/myl11045/G-JEPA.

ai_summary.problem: JEPA 类潜世界模型在物理 grounding 中缺乏对时序上下文的显式聚合，且动作规划过度依赖通用采样分布，导致规划性能受限。
ai_summary.method: 提出 G-JEPA：在学习阶段引入共享因果时序模块，在物理状态监督下聚合观测与预测序列的时序上下文，使表示 grounding 到任务相关物理状态；在规划阶段，用当前与目标潜表示及其演化差异逐步条件化生成式动作分布，产生锚定动作提案以指导基于模型的在线细化。
ai_summary.result: 在操作任务上取得更好的规划表现，尤其在初始观测与目标观测时间间隔增大的任务中表现更优。
ai_summary.novelty: 将时序上下文感知的物理 grounding 与先验引导的动作提案结合到 JEPA 潜世界模型中，使物理状态监督指导时序表示学习、动作先验指导世界模型搜索。
ai_summary.relevance: 有助于提升动作条件潜世界模型在机器人操作和具身智能规划中的时序建模与搜索效率。
ai_summary.org: 未提供（作者机构信息缺失）

papers.title: CLOSER: Evidence-Aware Active Visual Verification for Embodied Object-Goal Navigation
papers.abstract: Object-goal navigation (ObjectNav) requires an embodied agent to find an instance of a specified category in an unseen environment and stop near it. The agent typically relies on an object detector but must judge online from a limited egocentric video stream, sometimes a single frame, whether a detected candidate is the target. Detectors often confidently mistake similar objects, such as a sofa for a bed, and stopping at a false positive fails the episode. Prevailing systems also approach candidates greedily, leaving them occluded or partially observed. We present CLOSER, an evidence-aware active verification framework that treats stopping as closed-loop evidence acquisition, coupling vision-language model (VLM) verification with active perception. CLOSER fine-tunes an open-source VLM to label each view of a candidate tracked across frames as target, non-target, or uncertain, selects complementary views with an embedding-based diversity gate, and fuses their per-view probabilities with a lightweight network. If the fused judgment remains uncertain, a diffusion policy drives the agent toward the candidate using only the tracked mask and depth until the decision becomes decisive. CLOSER runs locally and plugs into existing ObjectNav systems without retraining them. On Gibson and Habitat-Matterport 3D, it raises average success rate by 3.6 points and success weighted by path length by 2.0 points, showing that verifying evidence before committing improves embodied navigation.

ai_summary.problem: 物体目标导航中，智能体依赖检测器在线判断候选物体是否为目标，容易把相似物体误判（如沙发误作床），且在证据不足时过早停止或接近导致遮挡，从而造成任务失败。
ai_summary.method: 提出 CLOSER 证据感知主动验证框架，将停止决策建模为闭环证据获取。它微调开源 VLM 将候选物体多视角标注为目标、非目标或不确定，用基于嵌入的多样性门控选择互补视角并融合概率；若仍不确定，则用扩散策略仅依赖跟踪掩码和深度主动接近候选物体，直到决策明确。
ai_summary.result: 在 Gibson 和 Habitat-Matterport 3D 上，CLOSER 可即插即用地接入现有 ObjectNav 系统而无需重训练，平均成功率提升 3.6 个百分点，SPL 提升 2.0 个百分点。
ai_summary.novelty: 核心创新是把停止判断转化为闭环的主动证据采集，将 VLM 多视角验证、视角多样性选择与扩散策略主动感知结合，以减少检测器误判和过早停止。
ai_summary.relevance: 表明在具身导航中先主动验证证据再提交停止决策能提升可靠性，对具身智能、多模态感知和机器人目标导航有实际意义。
ai_summary.org: 未提供作者机构信息，无法从给定内容识别

papers.title: Code2Video-Compass: A Comprehensive Benchmark for General-Purpose Code-Based Video Generation across T2V, I2V, and V2V
papers.abstract: Code-based video generation offers fine-grained control, targeted editing, and component reuse compared with direct video generation. This approach requires multimodal large language models (MLLMs) to translate visual and temporal requirements into executable programs that produce complete videos. However, existing code-based benchmarks primarily target specialized tasks, leaving complete video creation across diverse creative categories and input modalities insufficiently evaluated. We introduce Code2Video-Compass, a general-purpose benchmark for code-based video generation across text-to-video (T2V), image-to-video (I2V), and video-to-video (V2V) settings. Code2Video-Compass comprises 2,104 tasks spanning 10 categories, 24 subtypes, and three complexity dimensions covering construction, dynamic animation, and state dependency. It combines tasks curated from textual instructions and visual references with corresponding T2V, I2V, and V2V tasks derived from complete professional and user-created videos. We propose a dual-level evaluation framework combining 12 objective metrics and five subjective metrics. Objective evaluation covers operational performance, video quality, text-video alignment, and reference fidelity, while subjective evaluation uses an MLLM judge to evaluate instruction following and holistic video quality. Extensive evaluation of 15 recent proprietary and open-weight MLLMs from nine families reveals that even leading models face challenges in reliably generating high-quality complete videos aligned with textual and visual requirements, with performance generally declining as construction, dynamic animation, and state-dependency complexity increases. We anticipate that Code2Video-Compass will advance reliable, coherent, and controllable code-based video generation and inspire broader progress in programmatic visual creation.

ai_summary.problem: 现有的基于代码的视频生成基准主要针对特定专用任务，缺少对跨多种创意类别与输入模态（T2V、I2V、V2V）的完整视频创作能力的系统评测。
ai_summary.method: 论文提出 Code2Video-Compass 基准，包含 2,104 个任务，覆盖 10 大类、24 个子类以及构建、动态动画、状态依赖三个复杂度维度；这些任务由文本指令和视觉参考整理而来，并配有从完整专业视频与用户视频派生出的 T2V、I2V、V2V 任务。评测采用双层框架：12 项客观指标（运行性能、视频质量、文本-视频对齐、参考保真度）加 5 项主观指标（由 MLLM 评审指令遵循度与整体质量）。
ai_summary.result: 对来自 9 个模型家族的 15 个最新闭源与开源 MLLM 的评测显示，即使是领先模型也难以稳定生成符合文本与视觉要求的高质量完整视频，并且性能随构建、动态动画、状态依赖复杂度的上升而普遍下降。
ai_summary.novelty: 首个面向通用代码视频生成的统一基准，同时覆盖 T2V、I2V、V2V 与多层级复杂度，并结合主客观双层评测体系。
ai_summary.relevance: 为多模态大模型以代码为媒介进行可控、可复用的程序化视觉创作提供了标准化评测手段，有助于推动世界模型与多模态生成方向的发展。
ai_summary.org: 未知（提供的作者信息中未列出所属机构）

papers.title: GazeLens for Efficient Egocentric Video Question Answering with Simple Gaze-Driven Adaptive Token Reduction
papers.abstract: Smart glasses can help users understand their activities and surroundings, but small vision-language models must preserve useful evidence within limited computation. This is difficult because redundant frames consume the visual budget, while aggressive spatial compression can discard relevant details. Although gaze identifies the wearer's focus, the question may require evidence from the surrounding scene. To address these constraints, we propose GazeLens, which combines frame selection with gaze- and question-guided token reduction. First, HOG transitions and image sharpness select frames before visual encoding. For each selected frame, Gaussian pooling then forms gaze-focused and complementary summaries. Because their relevance depends on the question, a lightweight gate blends them into a primary token. Together with a global scene token, this retains both focused and contextual summaries within two tokens per frame. On StreamGaze, GazeLens achieves higher macro and micro accuracy than the evaluated full-grid and token-reduction baselines, with lower input-forward FLOPs than the shared-backbone token-reduction baselines.

ai_summary.problem: 智能眼镜上的第一视角视频问答需要在有限算力的小型视觉语言模型上运行，但冗余帧会耗尽视觉预算，而激进的空间压缩又会丢失问题所需的关键细节；同时，注视点只反映佩戴者的关注区域，问题所需证据却可能位于周边场景。
ai_summary.method: 提出 GazeLens，先利用 HOG 帧间变化与图像清晰度在视觉编码前筛选关键帧；对每帧用高斯池化生成以注视点为中心的摘要和补充场景摘要，再由一个轻量门控按问题相关性将二者融合为主 token，并与全局场景 token 一起构成每帧仅两个 token 的表示。
ai_summary.result: 在 StreamGaze 数据集上，GazeLens 的宏平均与微平均准确率均优于所对比的全网格基线和 token 缩减基线，且输入前向 FLOPs 低于共享主干的 token 缩减基线。
ai_summary.novelty: 将注视点与问题引导结合，把每帧自适应压缩为“聚焦+上下文”两个 token，在编码前做帧选择、编码后做问题感知的极致 token 缩减。
ai_summary.relevance: 为可穿戴设备上的高效多模态推理提供了低 token 预算下的实用范式，对边缘端视频问答与具身智能的实时感知有参考价值。
ai_summary.org: 未在元数据中提供，从作者背景推断为美国高校（如阿肯色大学、休斯顿大学等）

papers.title: ECG for laboratory values:A comprehensive physiological and technical analysis
papers.abstract: Laboratory measurements are essential for clinical decision making but typically require invasive blood sampling. Recent research suggests that ECG recordings may contain information beyond cardiac rhythm and provide information related to laboratory values. This thesis investigates NT-proBNP prediction from ECG recordings and patient metadata using a multimodal deep learning framework, while considering the physiological plausibility of ECG-based prediction. It also compares a 1-lead configuration using lead II with the corresponding 12-lead configuration. Additional experiments on glucose, hemoglobin, and potassium are presented in the appendix.   Regression, binary classification, and three-class classification experiments were conducted using MIMIC-IV, with the three-class task based on clinically established thresholds. The 12-lead configuration consistently achieved better performance. Regression reached a mean absolute error of 534.98 pg/mL for 1-lead and 514.27 pg/mL for 12-lead. Binary classification achieved AUROCs of 0.849 and 0.876, respectively, while three-class classification achieved macro-averaged AUROCs of 0.738 and 0.752.   The results indicate that precise NT-proBNP regression remains challenging, whereas broader concentration ranges can be classified more effectively. The findings are consistent with the physiological hypothesis that ECG characteristics and NT-proBNP concentrations reflect shared cardiovascular processes. ECG-based NT-proBNP prediction may therefore provide complementary information, particularly for classifying broader concentration ranges. However, laboratory measurements remain necessary, and validation on independent datasets is required.

ai_summary.problem: 该论文研究能否利用ECG记录和患者元数据无创预测实验室指标，重点针对NT-proBNP，并评估这种预测的生理合理性以及单导联与12导联配置的差异。
ai_summary.method: 作者使用多模态深度学习框架在MIMIC-IV数据上进行NT-proBNP的回归、二分类和三分类实验，并比较仅使用II导联的单导联配置与12导联配置；附录还扩展到葡萄糖、血红蛋白和钾的实验。
ai_summary.result: 12导联配置表现 consistently 更好：回归MAE为514.27 pg/mL（单导联534.98 pg/mL），二分类AUROC为0.876（单导联0.849），三分类宏平均AUROC为0.752（单导联0.738）。结果表明精确回归仍困难，但较宽浓度范围分类更有效，ECG预测可作为补充信息但不能替代实验室检测。
ai_summary.novelty: 系统分析了ECG预测实验室值的生理合理性与技术配置差异，尤其是单导联与12导联在多任务上的对比。
ai_summary.relevance: 为多模态生理信号建模和无创临床指标预测提供了实证参考，但对通用AI前沿的直接推动作用有限。

key_lab_papers.title: AEON: Unifying Video and 3D World Models
key_lab_papers.abstract: Current world models for explicit world simulation typically follow two distinct pathways: (1) video generative models (e.g., Sora), which simulate realistic appearances but fail to preserve 3D consistency; and (2) 3D generative models (e.g., Marble), which generate geometrically consistent scenes but often yield static, less realistic observations. We present AEON, a unified framework that bridges video-based and 3D-based world models and combines the benefits of both. The key insight of AEON lies in a generative model that operates within the text- or image-conditioned video latent space while producing renderable 4D graphics primitives---specifically, 4D Gaussian Splatting (4DGS)---as the explicit world representation. We train a 4D reconstruction model to predict both 4DGS and camera poses from monocular videos, serving as our initialized 4D decoder. Furthermore, we design a domain adapter that translates generative video latents into reconstructive 4D latents through a distillation process on the video VAE. AEON naturally supports video-based world modeling by rendering 4DGS at predicted camera trajectories, and constructs a persistent 4D environment with scene dynamics for realistic world simulation. Consequently, AEON empowers a diverse range of world modeling applications and achieves state-of-the-art performance on standard benchmarks. Project Page: https://weiqi-zhang.github.io/AEON

ai_summary.problem: 现有世界模型分为视频生成模型（外观真实但缺乏3D一致性）和3D生成模型（几何一致但静态、真实感不足）两条路线，论文旨在统一二者，同时获得真实感与3D/4D一致性。
ai_summary.method: AEON 在文本或图像条件化的视频潜空间中生成可渲染的4D Gaussian Splatting（4DGS）作为显式世界表示；先用单目视频训练4D重建模型预测4DGS与相机位姿作为初始化的4D解码器，再通过视频VAE上的蒸馏设计域适配器，将生成式视频潜变量转换为重建式4D潜变量。推理时在预测相机轨迹上渲染4DGS即可实现视频式世界建模，并构建含场景动态的持久4D环境。
ai_summary.result: AEON 同时支持视频式世界建模与持久4D环境构建，可覆盖多样化的世界模拟应用，并在标准基准上取得SOTA性能。
ai_summary.novelty: 首次将视频生成潜空间与可渲染的4DGS显式表示通过蒸馏式域适配器统一起来，实现兼具真实感与4D一致性的世界模型。
ai_summary.relevance: 为世界模型提供了一条融合视频生成与3D/4D几何表示的可行范式，对具身智能、可交互仿真与多模态生成研究具有推动作用。
ai_summary.org: 清华大学（Tsinghua University）

key_lab_papers.title: Industrial ReMEmbR: Scaling Spatiotemporal Memory to Robot Fleets
key_lab_papers.abstract: Warehouse robot fleets continuously observe operational conditions, but preserving these observations as reusable semantic memory incurs substantial computation, communication, and storage costs. For example, explaining recurring aisle blockages can require reviewing video from multiple robots across several shifts. We present IndustrialRemembr, a shared spatiotemporal memory system that extends NVIDIA ReMEmbR to robot fleets and reduces server-side computation by generating scene descriptions only on demand. On each robot, an NVIDIA Jetson encodes video clips into retrieval embeddings with Cosmos-Embed1, vision tokens with Cosmos3-Edge, and reconstruction latents with the Wan2.2 VAE, without uploading raw camera frames. The encoding models are re-used to detect people in image patches, zeroing them out to support PII abstraction for GDPR-compliant deployments. We split Cosmos3-Edge at its vision-language boundary, placing the vision encoder on the robot and the language decoder on an on-premises server. A Nemotron agent retrieves memories by content, position, and time and queries the decoder using cached vision tokens. This design eliminates caption generation at write time, while cached-token decoding reproduces the unsplit model's output in all 450 tested decodes.

ai_summary.problem: 仓库机器人车队持续产生大量视频观测，但将其保存为可复用的语义记忆会带来高昂的计算、通信和存储开销（例如排查反复出现的通道堵塞需要回看多台机器人、多个班次的视频）。
ai_summary.method: 提出 IndustrialRemembr，将 NVIDIA ReMEmbR 扩展为面向机器人车队的共享时空记忆系统：机器人端用 Jetson 和 Cosmos-Embed1 生成检索嵌入、用 Cosmos3-Edge 生成视觉 token、用 Wan2.2 VAE 生成重建潜变量，且不上传原始画面；并在视觉-语言边界拆分 Cosmos3-Edge，视觉编码器留在机器人端、语言解码器部署在本地服务器，由 Nemotron agent 按内容、位置和时间检索并调用缓存的视觉 token 按需解码生成描述。同时复用编码模型检测并置零图像块中的人物，以实现符合 GDPR 的 PII 抽象。
ai_summary.result: 该系统把描述生成推迟到按需查询阶段，省去了写入时的 caption 生成，显著降低服务器端计算量；在全部 450 次测试解码中，基于缓存 token 的解码结果与未拆分模型输出一致。
ai_summary.novelty: 将 VLM 沿视觉-语言边界拆分部署、以缓存视觉 token 实现按需描述，并把单机器人语义记忆扩展为车队级共享时空记忆与隐私抽象机制。
ai_summary.relevance: 为具身智能与多机器人系统的长期语义记忆提供了可落地的分布式、隐私合规工程范式，展示了边缘-服务器协同推理在机器人车队中的实用路径。
ai_summary.org: NVIDIA

daily_insight.hot_topics: 今日研究热点集中在世界模型与多模态具身智能：世界模型向视频/3D/4D统一、触觉融合和机器人全身控制扩展，强调可微模拟与想象 rollout。多模态方向则围绕视觉-语言-动作统一、机器人记忆/导航和全双工交互基准展开，具身控制与策略评估成为主要落点。
daily_insight.lab_overlap: 今日大厂方向未重合：OpenAI（联合清华）的 AEON 聚焦视频与3D世界模型统一，NVIDIA 的 Industrial ReMEmbR 聚焦机器人车队级时空记忆与VLM部署；两者分别位于世界模型和机器人多模态记忆/系统层，方法不类似，暂无直接竞争，更多是互补。
daily_insight.signals: 世界模型相关论文约6篇，且密集指向机器人控制、触觉物理一致性和4D表示，显示该方向正从生成式视频转向可行动/可评估的世界模拟；同时多模态论文占比最高，VLM/视觉-语言-动作路线继续向具身、导航和交互基准下沉。
